verdict.rationale: Grok Bot is itself an agent product: persistent cloud Bots that act on a computer, browser and terminal. That puts it in the MCP client role, so serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the pack shows it running as an MCP server, and the runtime probe found no public Grok Bot API, CLI, or MCP endpoint. Marketplace connectors are client-side and do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
